examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもに{新|あたら}しい{本|ほん}を{見|み}せた。
examples.english: I showed the child a new book.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}にレポートを{見|み}せてから{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I submitted the report after showing it to the teacher.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{旅行|りょこう}で{撮|と}った{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}せたら、とても{喜|よろこ}んでくれた。
examples.english: When I showed my friend the photos I took on the trip, they were very happy.

notes:
{見|み}せる is an ichidan verb meaning "to show" or "to display."

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {見|み}える (intransitive, to be visible)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- XにYを{見|み}せる: to show Y to X
- {写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}せる: to show photos
- {見|み}せてください: please show me
- お{見|み}せする: to show (humble)

EXTENDED MEANINGS:
- {力|ちから}を{見|み}せる: to demonstrate one's power
- やって{見|み}せる: to show (by doing)
- {意地|いじ}を{見|み}せる: to show one's pride/stubbornness

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {見|み}せびらかす: to show off, to flaunt
- {見|み}せかける: to pretend, to make it appear
